Optional coverages

You can extend your coverage with extras and additional guarantees:​

Exclusions and limitations

There are certain conditions under which the insurance may not pay out:​

  • Not for professional use​
  • In order to benefit from the agreed cover, you must correctly state who the usual driver of the vehicle is​
  • Medical costs are only covered if you have driver insurance​
  • Damage to your own car caused by you is only covered by comprehensive insurance.

Coverage for Car Purchase Protection

Buy your second-hand car with confidence.

Enjoy extra peace of mind with coverage for eligible repair costs if a hidden mechanical or functional defect is discovered after purchase.

Available for newly subscribed policies.

Unforeseen mechanical and functional defects discovered within the first 3 months after purchase or the first 5,000 km driven, whichever comes first.

This includes components such as the gearbox, suspension, parking sensors, airbag system, compressor, oil pump, alternator and engine.

Normal wear and tear, such as tyres, brakes, batteries and wipers.

Cosmetic damage and damage that was already visible before purchasing the vehicle are also excluded.​

Second-hand vehicles up to 6 years old with less than 100,000 km at the time of purchase.

The vehicle must be covered by a Mini Omnium or Full Omnium policy, sold with a valid Car-Pass certificate, and supported by a purchase invoice or purchase agreement.

We cover eligible repair costs up to €2,000 per claim.

A fixed excess of €600 applies.
The lists above are not exhaustive. Please read the detailed clause conditions before signing up.​

Price and term of ING Car Insurance?​

Your premium is based on various risk-related criteria and the information available at the time of your quote. The price may change when the contract is granted. You will always be informed.

Find out more about the segmentation policy.

Only contracts with identical parameters assessed at the same time have the same price. More details are available in our segmentation policy.​

This insurance is taken out for a period of 1 year and is automatically renewed each year, unless one of the parties objects.​

Withdrawal right
You have the right to withdraw from your contract within 14 calendar days after its conclusion, without penalty and without providing any reason. Instructions on how to exercise this right are available in your contractual documentation and via Home Bank and ING Banking app.
Complaints

Not entirely satisfied with the distribution of this product?
Our Complaints Department and Ombudsman are there to help you: How do I submit a complaint?

Do you have any comments or complaints about ING Car Insurance?
Contact NN online: mobility@nn.be

About insurance and conflicts of interest: 
You can consult the general information on the insurance policies and the conflicts of interest policy (including information on remuneration) of ING Belgium SA/NV and of the insurer NN Non-Life via www.ing.be > Charges and regulations > Information and regulations > Insurance.

Human assistance
If you require assistance or would like to discuss the product before concluding the contract, you may request assistance from one of our advisers through our contact channels.

An excess or deductible is the amount you have to pay yourself in the event of a claim. You only have to pay a deductible in case you have an accident for which your full comprehensive cover intervenes. With full comprehensive insurance, you can choose how much excess you want to pay when you sign up: 400 euros, 600 euros or 800 euros in the case of material damage to your own car caused by you. 
No excess is required if you take out mini-comprehensive car insurance. The same applies to glass breakage.
